outgoing.name: Africa
outgoing.excerpt: The European population breeds mainly in northern Europe, but in winter the birds can be found in north Africa and southernmost Europe.

outgoing.name: China
outgoing.excerpt: It is the most widespread of the oystercatchers, with three races breeding in western Europe, central Eurasia, Kamchatka, China, and Western coast of Korea.
